label: CD20
blurb: Antibodies that remove CD20-bearing B cells; the best-established way to quiet B-cell-driven disease.

label: CD19
blurb: Antibodies that remove a wider range of B cells, including plasmablasts.

label: BAFF / APRIL
blurb: Block the survival signals B cells and plasma cells depend on.

label: FcRn
blurb: Speed the clearance of pathogenic IgG antibodies.

label: C5
blurb: Stop the last step of the complement cascade.

label: C1s / C2
blurb: Block complement earlier, at the classical pathway.

label: CD19 CAR-T
blurb: Engineered T cells that reset the B-cell compartment.

label: BCMA CAR-T
blurb: Engineered T cells aimed at plasma cells.

label: CD20 CAR-T
blurb: Engineered T cells aimed at CD20-bearing B cells.

label: BTK
blurb: Oral drugs that act on B cells and microglia.

label: IL-6 receptor
blurb: Block interleukin-6 signalling.

label: CD40L / CD3
blurb: Interrupt the T-cell and B-cell conversation.

label: IL-17A
blurb: Block interleukin-17A, a driver of tissue inflammation.

label: CD38
blurb: Antibodies that remove CD38-bearing plasma cells.

label: S1P receptor
blurb: Keep lymphocytes in the lymph nodes, out of the brain.

label: α4-integrin
blurb: Stop lymphocytes crossing into the brain.

label: Fumarates
blurb: Activate the Nrf2 antioxidant pathway.

label: DHODH
blurb: Slow the division of activated lymphocytes.

label: CD52
blurb: Remove lymphocytes broadly, then let them rebuild.

label: Interferon-β
blurb: The oldest disease-modifying class.

label: Cladribine
blurb: A purine analogue that removes dividing lymphocytes.

label: Glucocorticoids
blurb: Steroids for relapses and as a comparator; also given alongside other drugs.

label: ACTH
blurb: Adrenocorticotropic hormone for relapses.

label: Clemastine
blurb: An antihistamine tested for remyelination.

label: LINGO-1 / RGMa
blurb: Aim to restore myelin and protect axons.

label: Syncytin-1
blurb: Antibody against a retroviral envelope protein.

label: Fampridine
blurb: Potassium-channel blocker for walking in MS.

label: Cannabinoids
blurb: Cannabinoid drugs tested for spasticity and pain.
